sentences.zh: 五行傳曰：「治宮室，飾臺榭，內淫亂，犯親戚，侮父兄，則稼穡不成。

translations.literal: The Treatise on the Five Elements says: "If one builds palaces, adorns terraces and pavilions, is internally licentious and disorderly, offends against kin, and insults fathers and elder brothers, then grain crops will not succeed."
translations.idiomatic: The Treatise on the Five Elements states: "When rulers lavish effort on palaces and adorned terraces, harbor inner licentiousness, offend against kin, and show contempt for fathers and elder brothers, grain crops fail to ripen."

sentences.zh: 」謂土失其性，則有水旱之災，草木百穀不熟也。

translations.literal: " This means that when earth loses its proper nature, there are disasters of flood and drought, and grasses, trees, and the hundred grains do not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: This refers to earth losing its proper character: flood and drought follow, and grasses, trees, and every grain fail to mature.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「思心不睿，是謂不聖。

translations.literal: It also says: "If the thoughtful mind lacks perspicacity, this is called un-sagely."
translations.idiomatic: It further says: "When the deliberative mind lacks clarity, this is called being unsagely."

sentences.zh: 厥咎霿，厥罰常風，厥極凶短折。

translations.literal: Its blame is gloom and mist, its penalty is persistent wind, its extreme is untimely death and shortened life.
translations.idiomatic: The blame lies in gloom and murk, the penalty in persistent wind, and the extreme manifestation in untimely death.

sentences.zh: 時則有脂夜之妖，時則有華孽、臝蟲之孽，時則有牛禍，時則有心腹之痾，時則有黃眚黃祥，時則有木、火、金、水沴土。

translations.literal: At times there are demons of the fat night; at times portents of flowers and calamities of naked insects; at times bovine disasters; at times ailments of the heart and bowels; at times yellow omens and yellow auspices; at times wood, fire, metal, and water injuring earth.
translations.idiomatic: Then come demons of the murky night; portents of strange blossoms and calamities of naked insects; disasters involving cattle; diseases of the heart and bowels; yellow omens and yellow auspices; and wood, fire, metal, and water harming earth.

sentences.zh: 稼穡不成。

translations.literal: Grain crops do not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Grain crops fail to ripen.

sentences.zh: 貞觀元年，關內饑。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhenguan, famine in Guannei.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhenguan (627), famine struck the Guannei region.

sentences.zh: 總章二年，諸州四十餘饑，關中尤甚。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zongzhang, more than forty prefectures suffered famine; Guanzhong was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zongzhang (669), famine hit more than forty prefectures; the Guanzhong region was hardest hit.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳四年春，東都饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Yifeng, famine in the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year of Yifeng (679), famine struck the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 調露元年秋，關中饑。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Tiaolu, famine in Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Tiaolu (679), famine struck Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 永隆元年冬，東都饑。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Yonglong, famine in the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of Yonglong (680), famine struck the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 永淳元年，關中及山南州二十六饑，京師人相食。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongchun, Guanzhong and twenty-six prefectures of Shannan suffered famine; people in the capital ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongchun (682), famine afflicted Guanzhong and twenty-six prefectures south of the mountains; in the capital people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 垂拱三年，天下饑。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chuigong, famine throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chuigong (687), famine spread across the empire.

sentences.zh: 大足元年春，河南諸州饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Dazu, famine in the prefectures of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Dazu (701), famine struck the prefectures of Henan.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年春，饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Jinglong, famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of Jinglong (708), famine occurred.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，饑。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year (709), famine occurred.

sentences.zh: 先天二年冬，京師、岐、隴、幽州饑。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year of Xiantian, famine in the capital, Qi, Long, and You prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the second year of Xiantian (713), famine struck the capital and the Qi, Long, and You regions.

sentences.zh: 開元十六年，河北饑。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Kaiyuan, famine in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Kaiyuan (728), famine struck Hebei.

sentences.zh: 乾元三年春，饑，米斗錢千五百。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year of Qianyuan, famine; a dou of rice cost fifteen hundred cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year of Qianyuan (760), famine struck; a dou of rice sold for fifteen hundred cash.

sentences.zh: 廣德二年秋，關輔饑，米斗千錢。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year of Guangde, famine in Guanfu; a dou of rice cost a thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the second year of Guangde (764), famine afflicted the Guanfu region; a dou of rice sold for a thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 永泰元年，饑，京師米斗千錢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongtai, famine; in the capital a dou of rice cost a thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongtai (765), famine struck; in the capital a dou of rice sold for a thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 貞元元年春，大饑，東都、河南、河北米斗千錢，死者相枕。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Zhenyuan, great famine; in the Eastern Capital, Henan, and Hebei a dou of rice cost a thousand cash, and the dead lay one atop another.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Zhenyuan (785), a severe famine struck; in the Eastern Capital, Henan, and Hebei a dou of rice sold for a thousand cash, and corpses lay piled upon one another.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，麥將登而雨霖，米斗千錢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, wheat was about to ripen when continuous rain fell; a dou of rice cost a thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year (786), wheat was nearly ready for harvest when unending rain fell; a dou of rice sold for a thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 十四年，京師及河南饑。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, famine in the capital and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (798), famine struck the capital and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十九年秋，關輔饑。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the nineteenth year, famine in Guanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the nineteenth year (803), famine afflicted the Guanfu region.

sentences.zh: 元和七年春，饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year of Yuanhe, famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year of Yuanhe (812), famine occurred.

sentences.zh: 八年，廣州饑。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, famine in Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (813), famine struck Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年春，關內饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year, famine in Guannei.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year (814), famine struck the Guannei region.

sentences.zh: 十一年，東都、陳許州饑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, famine in the Eastern Capital and Chenxu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (816), famine struck the Eastern Capital and Chenxu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 長慶二年，江淮饑。

translations.literal: In the second year of Changqing, famine in the Jianghuai region.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Changqing (822), famine struck the Jianghuai region.

sentences.zh: 大和四年，河北及太原饑。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dahe, famine in Hebei and Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dahe (830), famine struck Hebei and Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 六年春，劍南饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, famine in Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year (832), famine struck Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 九年春，饑，河北尤甚。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year, famine; Hebei was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year (835), famine occurred; Hebei was hardest hit.

sentences.zh: 開成四年，溫、台、明等州饑。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kaicheng, famine in Wen, Tai, Ming, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kaicheng (839), famine struck Wen, Tai, Ming, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 大中五年冬，湖南饑。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year of Dazhong, famine in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifth year of Dazhong (851), famine struck Hunan.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，淮南饑，海陵、高郵民於官河中漉得異米，號「聖米」。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixth year, famine in Huainan; the people of Hailing and Gaoyou strained strange rice from the official canal and called it "Sacred Rice."
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the sixth year (852), famine struck Huainan; people in Hailing and Gaoyou strained unusual rice from the official canal and called it "Sacred Rice."

sentences.zh: 九年秋，淮南饑。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the ninth year, famine in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the ninth year (855), famine struck Huainan.

sentences.zh: 咸通三年夏，淮南、河南饑。

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year of Xiantong, famine in Huainan and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year of Xiantong (862), famine struck Huainan and Henan.

sentences.zh: 九年秋，江左及關內饑，東都尤甚。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the ninth year, famine in the lands east of the Yangtze and in Guannei; the Eastern Capital was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the ninth year (868), famine afflicted the lands east of the Yangtze and the Guannei region; the Eastern Capital was hardest hit.

sentences.zh: 乾符三年春，京師饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year of Qianfu, famine in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year of Qianfu (876), famine struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 中和二年，關內大饑。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhonghe, great famine in Guannei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhonghe (882), a severe famine struck the Guannei region.

sentences.zh: 四年，關內大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, great famine in Guannei; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (884), a severe famine afflicted Guannei; people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 光啟二年二月，荊、襄大饑，米斗三千錢，人相食。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Guangqi, great famine in Jing and Xiang; a dou of rice cost three thousand cash; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Guangqi (886), severe famine struck Jing and Xiang; a dou of rice sold for three thousand cash, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 三年，揚州大饑，米斗萬錢。

translations.literal: In the third year, great famine in Yangzhou; a dou of rice cost ten thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (887), severe famine struck Yangzhou; a dou of rice sold for ten thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 大順二年春，淮南大饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Dashun, great famine in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of Dashun (891), severe famine struck Huainan.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年十月，京師大饑。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Tianyou, great famine in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Tianyou (904), severe famine struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 常風。

translations.literal: Persistent wind.
translations.idiomatic: Persistent wind.

sentences.zh: 武德二年十二月壬子，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the renzi day, of the second year of Wude, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Wude (619), on the renzi day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 易巽為風，「重巽以申命」。

translations.literal: In the Changes, Xun represents wind: "Double Xun to proclaim commands."
translations.idiomatic: In the Book of Changes, the trigram Xun represents wind: "Double Xun to proclaim commands."

sentences.zh: 其及物也，象人君誥命，其鼓動於天地間，有時飛沙揚塵，怒也，發屋拔木者，怒甚也。

translations.literal: In its effect on things, it resembles a ruler's proclamation; as it stirs between heaven and earth, at times it raises flying sand and dust—that is anger; when it tears off roofs and uproots trees, that is great anger.
translations.idiomatic: In its effect upon the world it resembles a ruler's proclamation; stirring through heaven and earth, it sometimes raises flying sand and dust in anger, and when it tears off roofs and uproots trees, its wrath is extreme.

sentences.zh: 其占：「大臣專恣而氣盛，眾逆同志，君行蒙暗，施於事則皆傷害，故常風。

translations.literal: Its omen reading: "When great ministers are willful and their qi is strong, many rebels share the same intent, and the ruler's conduct is dark and obscured—when applied to affairs all are harmed; therefore persistent wind."
translations.idiomatic: Its interpretation runs: "When great ministers grow willful and overbearing, many rebels share a common purpose, and the ruler's conduct grows dark and obscured—applied to affairs, all suffer harm; hence persistent wind."

sentences.zh: 」又「飄風入宮闕，一日再三，若風聲如雷觸地而起，為兵將興。

translations.literal: " It also says: "When gusting wind enters the palace gates, three or four times in a day, and if the sound of wind like thunder strikes the ground and rises, armies will arise."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "When gusting wind enters the palace gates several times in a single day, and the wind sounds like thunder striking the ground and rising, armies will soon arise."

sentences.zh: 貞觀十四年六月乙酉，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yiyou day, of the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourteenth year of Zhenguan (640), on the yiyou day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 咸亨四年八月己酉，大風落太廟鴟尾。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jiyou day, of the fourth year of Xianheng, a great wind knocked down the owl-tail ornaments of the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Xianheng (673), on the jiyou day, a great wind knocked down the owl-tail ornaments of the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 永隆二年七月，雍州大風害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Yonglong, a great wind in Yongzhou harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Yonglong (681), a great wind in Yongzhou damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 弘道元年十二月壬午晦，宋州大風拔木。

translations.literal: On the last day of the twelfth month, the renwu day, of the first year of Hongdao, a great wind in Songzhou uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the twelfth month of the first year of Hongdao (683), the renwu day, a great wind in Songzhou uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 嗣聖元年四月丁巳，寧州大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the dingsi day, of the first year of Sisheng, a great wind in Ningzhou uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Sisheng (684), on the dingsi day, a great wind in Ningzhou uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 垂拱四年十月辛亥，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the xinhai day, of the fourth year of Chuigong, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Chuigong (688), on the xinhai day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 永昌二年五月丁亥，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the dinghai day, of the second year of Yongchang, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Yongchang (689), on the dinghai day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年三月乙酉，睦州大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yiyou day, of the first year of Shenlong, a great wind in Muzhou uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Shenlong (705), on the yiyou day, a great wind in Muzhou uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 崔玄暐封博陵郡王也，大風折其輅蓋。

translations.literal: When Cui Xuanwei was enfeoffed as Prince of Boling commandery, a great wind broke the canopy of his carriage.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Xuanwei was enfeoffed as Prince of Boling, a great wind broke the canopy of his carriage.

sentences.zh: 二年六月乙亥，滑州大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yihai day, of the second year, a great wind in Huazhou uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year (706), on the yihai day, a great wind in Huazhou uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 景龍元年七月，郴州大風，發屋拔木。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Jinglong, a great wind in Chenzhou tore off roofs and uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Jinglong (707), a great wind in Chenzhou tore off roofs and uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 八月，宋州大風拔木，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, a great wind in Songzhou uprooted trees and destroyed dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a great wind in Songzhou uprooted trees and destroyed houses.

sentences.zh: 二年十月辛亥，滑州暴風發屋。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the xinhai day, of the second year, a violent wind in Huazhou tore off roofs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year (708), on the xinhai day, a violent wind in Huazhou tore off roofs.

sentences.zh: 三年三月辛未，曹州大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinwei day, of the third year, a great wind in Caozhou uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year (709), on the xinwei day, a great wind in Caozhou uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 開元二年六月，京師大風發屋，大木拔者十七八。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Kaiyuan, a great wind in the capital tore off roofs; seven or eight out of ten large trees were uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Kaiyuan (714), a great wind in the capital tore off roofs; seven or eight out of every ten large trees were uprooted.

sentences.zh: 四年六月辛未，京師、陝、華大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the xinwei day, of the fourth year, great winds in the capital, Shan, and Hua uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year (716), on the xinwei day, great winds in the capital, Shan, and Hua uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 九年七月丙辰，揚州、潤州暴風雨，發屋拔木。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the bingchen day, of the ninth year, violent wind and rain in Yangzhou and Runzhou tore off roofs and uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year (721), on the bingchen day, violent wind and rain in Yangzhou and Runzhou tore off roofs and uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 十四年六月戊午，大風拔木發屋，端門鴟尾盡落。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuwu day, of the fourteenth year, a great wind uprooted trees and tore off roofs; all the owl-tail ornaments of the Duan Gate fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourteenth year (726), on the wuwu day, a great wind uprooted trees and tore off roofs; all the owl-tail ornaments of the Duan Gate fell.

sentences.zh: 端門，號令所從出也。

translations.literal: The Duan Gate is where commands issue forth.
translations.idiomatic: The Duan Gate is where imperial commands issue forth.

sentences.zh: 十九年六月乙酉，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yiyou day, of the nineteenth year, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the nineteenth year (731), on the yiyou day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 二十二年五月戊子，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the wuzi day, of the twenty-second year, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-second year (734), on the wuzi day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 天寶十一載五月甲子，東京大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiazi day, of the eleventh year of Tianbao, a great wind in the Eastern Capital uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year of Tianbao (752), on the jiazi day, a great wind in the Eastern Capital uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 十三載三月辛酉，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinyou day, of the thirteenth year, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirteenth year (754), on the xinyou day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 永泰元年三月辛亥，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinhai day, of the first year of Yongtai, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Yongtai (765), on the xinhai day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 大曆七年五月乙酉，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the yiyou day, of the seventh year of Dali, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year of Dali (772), on the yiyou day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 十年五月甲寅，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, of the tenth year, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year (775), on the jiayin day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 貞元元年七月庚子，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the gengzi day, of the first year of Zhenyuan, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhenyuan (785), on the gengzi day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 六年四月甲申，大風雨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the jiashen day, of the sixth year, great wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year (790), on the jiashen day, a great wind and rainstorm occurred.

sentences.zh: 八年五月己未，暴風發太廟屋瓦，毀門闕、官署、廬舍不可勝紀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiwei day, of the eighth year, a violent wind tore off the roof tiles of the Grand Temple and destroyed gate towers, government offices, and dwellings beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year (792), on the jiwei day, a violent wind tore off the roof tiles of the Grand Temple and destroyed gate towers, government offices, and dwellings beyond number.

sentences.zh: 十年六月辛未，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the xinwei day, of the tenth year, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year (794), on the xinwei day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月癸未，廣州大風，壞屋覆舟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the guiwei day, of the fourteenth year, a great wind in Guangzhou destroyed houses and capsized boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year (798), on the guiwei day, a great wind in Guangzhou destroyed houses and capsized boats.

sentences.zh: 元和元年六月丙申，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingshen day, of the first year of Yuanhe, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Yuanhe (806), on the bingshen day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 三年四月壬申，大風毀含元殿欄檻二十七間。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the renshen day, of the third year, a great wind destroyed twenty-seven bays of railing at Hanyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year (808), on the renshen day, a great wind destroyed twenty-seven bays of railing at Hanyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 占為兵起。

translations.literal: The omen reading is that armies will arise.
translations.idiomatic: This was interpreted as a portent of war.

sentences.zh: 四年十月壬午，天有氣如煙，臭如燔皮，日昳大風而止。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the renwu day, of the fourth year, the sky had qi like smoke, smelling like burning hide; at mid-afternoon a great wind arose and it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year (809), on the renwu day, vapor like smoke filled the sky, smelling of burning hide; a great wind arose at mid-afternoon and it ceased.

sentences.zh: 五年三月丙子，大風毀崇陵上宮衙殿鴟尾及神門戟竿六，壞行垣四十間。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the bingzi day, of the fifth year, a great wind destroyed the owl-tail ornaments of the upper palace office hall at Chongling and six halberd poles at the spirit gate, and damaged forty bays of the enclosing subject.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year (810), on the bingzi day, a great wind destroyed the owl-tail ornaments of the upper palace office hall at Chongling and six halberd poles at the spirit gate, and damaged forty bays of the corridor wall.

sentences.zh: 八年六月庚寅，京師大風雨，毀屋飄瓦，人多壓死者。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengyin day, of the eighth year, a great wind and rain in the capital destroyed houses and scattered roof tiles; many people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year (813), on the gengyin day, a great wind and rainstorm in the capital destroyed houses and scattered roof tiles; many people were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 丙申，富平大風，拔棗木千餘株。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, a great wind in Fuping uprooted more than a thousand jujube trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, a great wind in Fuping uprooted more than a thousand jujube trees.

sentences.zh: 十二年春，青州一夕暴風自西北，天地晦冥，空中有若旌旗狀，屋瓦上如蹂躒聲。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year, in Qingzhou one night a violent wind came from the northwest; heaven and earth were dark and murky; in the sky there were shapes like banners and flags, and on roof tiles sounds like trampling.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twelfth year (817), in Qingzhou a violent wind from the northwest blew one night; heaven and earth turned dark and murky; banner-like shapes appeared in the sky, and roof tiles rattled as if under trampling feet.

sentences.zh: 有日者占之曰：「不及五年，茲地當大殺戮。

translations.literal: A diviner by the sun read it and said: "In less than five years, this place will see great slaughter."
translations.idiomatic: A diviner who read the heavens said: "Within five years this place will witness great slaughter."

sentences.zh: 長慶二年正月己酉，大風霾。

translations.literal: In the first month, on the jiyou day, of the second year of Changqing, a great wind and haze.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Changqing (822), on the jiyou day, a great wind brought haze.

sentences.zh: 十月，夏州大風，飛沙為堆，高及城堞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, a great wind in Xizhou piled flying sand into heaps as high as the battlements.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, a great wind in Xizhou piled flying sand into heaps as high as the city battlements.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丁巳朔，大風，昏霾終日。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month, the dingsi day, of the third year, a great wind; murky haze lasted all day.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of the third year (823), the dingsi day, a great wind blew; murky haze lasted all day.

sentences.zh: 四年六月庚寅，大風毀延喜門及景風門。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengyin day, of the fourth year, a great wind destroyed the Yanxi Gate and the Jingfeng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year (824), on the gengyin day, a great wind destroyed the Yanxi Gate and the Jingfeng Gate.

sentences.zh: 大和八年六月癸未，暴風壞長安縣署及經行寺塔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the guiwei day, of the eighth year of Dahe, a violent wind destroyed the Chang'an county office and the pagoda of Jingxing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year of Dahe (834), on the guiwei day, a violent wind destroyed the Chang'an county office and the pagoda of Jingxing Temple.

sentences.zh: 九年四月辛丑，大風拔木萬株，墮含元殿四鴟尾，拔殿廷樹三，壞金吾仗舍，發城門樓觀內外三十餘所，光化門西城十數雉壞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the xinchou day, of the ninth year, a great wind uprooted ten thousand trees, caused four owl-tail ornaments of Hanyuan Hall to fall, uprooted three court-yard trees, damaged the Jinwu guard barracks, destroyed more than thirty gate towers and pavilions inside and outside the city, and at Guanghua Gate on the west of the city damaged a dozen or so battlement sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the ninth year of Dahe (835), on the xinchou day, a great wind uprooted ten thousand trees, knocked down four owl-tail ornaments on Hanyuan Hall, uprooted three trees in the palace courtyard, wrecked the Jinwu guard barracks, and tore down more than thirty gate towers and pavilions inside and outside the city; at Guanghua Gate on the west side of the capital, a dozen or more sections of the battlements were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 開成三年正月戊辰，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the first month, on the wuchen day, of the third year of Kaicheng, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of Kaicheng (838), on the wuchen day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 五年四月甲子，大風拔木；

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the jiazi day, of the fifth year, a great wind uprooted trees;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year (840), on the jiazi day, a great wind uprooted trees;

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，亦如之；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the renyin day, it was likewise;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renyin day, the same thing occurred;

sentences.zh: 七月戊寅，亦如之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the wuyin day, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the wuyin day, it happened again.

sentences.zh: 會昌元年三月，黔南大風飄瓦。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Huichang, a great wind in Qiannan scattered roof tiles.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Huichang (841), a great wind in southern Guizhou scattered roof tiles.

sentences.zh: 咸通六年正月，絳州大風拔木，有十圍者。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year of Xiantong, a great wind in Jiangzhou uprooted trees, including some ten arm-spans around.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year of Xiantong (865), a great wind in Jiangzhou uprooted trees, some of them ten arm-spans in girth.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯晦，潼關夜中大風，山如吼雷，河噴石鳴，羣烏亂飛，重關傾側。

translations.literal: On the last day of the eleventh month, the jimao day, at Tong Pass in the middle of the night a great wind blew; the mountains roared like thunder, the river spewed stones with a rumbling sound, flocks of crows flew in disorder, and the layered pass swayed and leaned.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the eleventh month, the jimao day, a great wind blew through Tong Pass in the dead of night; the mountains thundered, the river cast up stones with a roaring sound, crows flew wildly in every direction, and the layered fortress swayed on its foundations.

sentences.zh: 十二月，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 乾符五年五月丁酉，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the dingyou day, of the fifth year of Qianfu, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Qianfu (878), on the dingyou day, a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 廣明元年四月甲申，京師及東都、汝州雨雹，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the jiashen day, of the first year of Guangming, the capital, the Eastern Capital, and Ruzhou had hail; a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Guangming (880), on the jiashen day, hail fell in the capital, the Eastern Capital, and Ruzhou, and a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 四年六月乙巳，太原大風雨，拔木千株，害稼百里。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yisi day, of the fourth year, a great wind and rain in Taiyuan uprooted a thousand trees and damaged crops for a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year (883), on the yisi day, a great wind and rainstorm in Taiyuan uprooted a thousand trees and destroyed crops across a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 光化三年七月乙丑，洺州大風，拔木發屋。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the yichou day, of the third year of Guanghua, a great wind in Mingzhou uprooted trees and tore off roofs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Guanghua (900), on the yichou day, a great wind in Mingzhou uprooted trees and tore roofs from houses.

sentences.zh: 天復二年，昇州大風，發屋飛大木。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianfu, a great wind in Shengzhou tore off roofs and sent large trees flying.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianfu (902), a great wind in Shengzhou tore roofs from houses and hurled large trees through the air.

sentences.zh: 夜妖。

translations.literal: Demons of the night.
translations.idiomatic: Night omens.

sentences.zh: 大和九年十一月戊辰，晝晦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the wuchen day, of the ninth year of Dahe, the day turned dark.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the ninth year of Dahe (835), on the wuchen day, daylight faded into darkness.

sentences.zh: 咸通七年九月辛卯朔，天闇。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, the xinmao day, of the seventh year of Xiantong, heaven darkened.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month of the seventh year of Xiantong (866), the xinmao day, the sky went dark.

sentences.zh: 乾符二年二月，宣武境內黑風，雨土。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Qianfu, within the borders of Xuanwu a black wind blew and earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Qianfu (875), a black wind swept through the Xuanwu region and earth fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年閏四月乙未朔，大風，雨土。

translations.literal: On the first day of the intercalary fourth month, the yiwei day, of the first year of Tianyou, a great wind blew and earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary fourth month of the first year of Tianyou (904), the yiwei day, a great wind blew and earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 華孽。

translations.literal: Portents of flowers.
translations.idiomatic: Flower portents.

sentences.zh: 延載元年九月，內出梨華一枝示宰相。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Yanzai, from within the palace a branch of pear blossom was produced and shown to the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Yanzai (694), the palace produced a branch of pear blossom and displayed it to the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 萬木搖落而生華，陰陽黷也。

translations.literal: When the myriad trees were shedding leaves yet produced blossoms, yin and yang were corrupted.
translations.idiomatic: When the myriad trees were shedding their leaves yet burst into blossom, yin and yang had fallen out of balance.

sentences.zh: 傳曰：「天反時為災。

translations.literal: The Treatise says: "When heaven reverses the seasons, it becomes a disaster."
translations.idiomatic: The Treatise says: "When heaven reverses the seasons, calamity follows."

sentences.zh: 」又近常燠也。

translations.literal: " It also approximates persistent heat.
translations.idiomatic: This also approximates a portent of unseasonable warmth.

sentences.zh: 神龍二年十月，陳州李有華，鮮茂如春。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year of Shenlong, in Chenzhou plums bore blossoms, fresh and luxuriant as in spring.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of Shenlong (706), plums blossomed in Chenzhou, fresh and lush as though it were spring.

sentences.zh: 元和十一年十二月，桃杏華。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year of Yuanhe, peach and apricot blossomed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year of Yuanhe (816), peach and apricot trees came into bloom.

sentences.zh: 大和二年九月，徐州、滑州李有華，實可食。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Dahe, in Xuzhou and Huazhou plums bore blossoms, and the fruit was edible.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Dahe (828), plums blossomed in Xuzhou and Huazhou, and the fruit that formed was fit to eat.

sentences.zh: 會昌三年冬，沁源桃李華。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year of Huichang, peach and plum blossomed in Qinyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the third year of Huichang (843), peach and plum trees blossomed in Qinyuan.

sentences.zh: 廣明元年冬，桃李華，山華皆發。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Guangming, peach and plum blossomed, and mountain flowers all opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of Guangming (880), peach and plum trees blossomed, and wildflowers on the hills all burst into bloom.

sentences.zh: 中和二年九月，太原諸山桃杏華，有實。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Zhonghe, on the various mountains around Taiyuan peach and apricot blossomed, and there was fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Zhonghe (882), peach and apricot trees blossomed on the mountains around Taiyuan, and some even bore fruit.

sentences.zh: 景福中，滄州城塹中冰有文，如畫大樹華葉芬敷者，時人以為其地當有兵難。

translations.literal: During the Jingfu era, in the moat of Cangzhou city the ice bore markings like painted great trees with flowers and leaves in full spread; people of the time thought that place would suffer military calamity.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jingfu era (892–893), the ice in the moat at Cangzhou bore patterns like painted trees in full leaf and blossom; people of the time took this as a sign that the region would soon see war.

sentences.zh: 近華孽也。

translations.literal: This approximates a portent of flowers.
translations.idiomatic: This too was taken as a flower portent.

sentences.zh: 臝蟲之孽。

translations.literal: Calamities of naked insects.
translations.idiomatic: Insect calamities.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二十一年八月，萊州螟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-first year of Zhenguan, stem borers in Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-first year of Zhenguan (647), stem borers infested Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 開元二十二年八月，榆關虸蚄蟲害稼，入平州界，有羣雀來食之，一日而盡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-second year of Kaiyuan, at Yuguan armyworms damaged the crops; entering the border of Pingzhou, flocks of sparrows came and ate them, and in one day they were gone.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-second year of Kaiyuan (734), armyworms ravaged the crops at Yuguan; when they crossed into Pingzhou, flocks of sparrows descended on them and devoured them all in a single day.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，榆關虸蚄蟲害稼，羣雀來食之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, at Yuguan armyworms damaged the crops; flocks of sparrows came and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (738), armyworms again ravaged the crops at Yuguan, and flocks of sparrows came and ate them.

sentences.zh: 三載，青州紫蟲食田，有鳥食之。

translations.literal: In the third year, purple insects ate the fields in Qingzhou; birds came and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianbao (744), purple insects devoured the fields in Qingzhou, and birds came and ate the insects.

sentences.zh: 廣德元年秋，虸蚄蟲害稼，關中尤甚，米斗千錢。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Guangde, armyworms damaged the crops; Guanzhong was especially severe, and a dou of rice cost a thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Guangde (763), armyworms ravaged the crops; Guanzhong suffered worst of all, and a dou of rice sold for a thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 貞元十年四月，江西溪澗魚頭皆戴蚯蚓。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the tenth year of Zhenyuan, in Jiangxi the heads of fish in streams and brooks all wore earthworms.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the tenth year of Zhenyuan (794), in Jiangxi earthworms clung to the heads of fish in every stream and brook.

sentences.zh: 長慶四年，絳州虸蚄蟲害稼。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Changqing, armyworms damaged the crops in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Changqing (824), armyworms ravaged the crops in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 大和元年秋，河東、同虢等州虸蚄蟲害稼。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Dahe, in Hedong, Tong, Guo, and other prefectures armyworms damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Dahe (827), armyworms ravaged the crops in Hedong, Tong, Guo, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 開成元年，京城有蟻聚，長五六十步，闊五尺至一丈，厚五寸至一尺者。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaicheng, in the capital there were ant swarms fifty or sixty paces long, five chi to one zhang wide, and five cun to one chi thick.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaicheng (836), ant swarms appeared in the capital measuring fifty or sixty paces long, five chi to one zhang wide, and five cun to one chi thick.

sentences.zh: 四年，河南黑蟲食田。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, black insects ate the fields in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (839), black insects devoured the fields in Henan.

sentences.zh: 牛禍。

translations.literal: Bovine disasters.
translations.idiomatic: Cattle omens.

sentences.zh: 調露元年春，牛大疫。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Tiaolu, a great cattle plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Tiaolu (679), a great cattle plague broke out.

sentences.zh: 京房易傳曰：「牛少者穀不成。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "When cattle are few, grain crops do not succeed."
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "When cattle are scarce, grain crops fail to ripen."

sentences.zh: 」又占曰：「金革動。

translations.literal: " The omen reading also says: "Metal and leather stir."
translations.idiomatic: " The omen reading also says: "Arms and war are set in motion."

sentences.zh: 長安中，有獻牛無前膊，三足而行者。

translations.literal: During the Chang'an period, there was presented a cow without forelegs that walked on three legs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chang'an period, someone presented a cow lacking forelegs that walked on three legs.

sentences.zh: 又有牛膊上生數足，蹄甲皆具者。

translations.literal: There was also a cow on whose shoulder grew several feet, complete with hooves and nails.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a cow that grew several extra legs from its shoulder, each complete with hooves and nails.

sentences.zh: 武太后從姊之子司農卿宗晉卿家牛生三角。

translations.literal: At the home of Zong Jinqing, Minister of Agriculture and son of Empress Wu's cousin on her mother's side, a cow grew three horns.
translations.idiomatic: At the home of Zong Jinqing, Minister of Agriculture and maternal cousin's son of Empress Wu, a cow was born with three horns.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年春，牛疫。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Shenlong, a cattle plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Shenlong (705), a cattle plague broke out.

sentences.zh: 二年冬，牛大疫。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year, a great cattle plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the second year (706), a great cattle plague broke out.

sentences.zh: 先天初，洛陽市有牛，左脅有人手，長一尺，或牽之以乞丐。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xiantian, in the Luoyang market there was a cow with a human hand on its left flank, one chi long; sometimes it was led about to beg.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xiantian era (712), a cow in the Luoyang market bore a human hand a foot long on its left flank; its owner sometimes led it about to beg for alms.

sentences.zh: 開元十五年春，河北牛大疫。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year of Kaiyuan, a great cattle plague in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year of Kaiyuan (727), a great cattle plague struck Hebei.

sentences.zh: 大曆八年，武功、櫟陽民家牛生犢，二首。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Dali, among the common households of Wugong and Liyang a cow bore a calf with two heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Dali (773), a cow among the common households of Wugong and Liyang bore a calf with two heads.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年，牛疫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan, a cattle plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyuan (786), a cattle plague broke out.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，郊牛生犢，六足。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, the suburban sacrificial ox bore a calf with six legs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year (788), the suburban sacrificial ox bore a calf with six legs.

sentences.zh: 足多者，下不一。

translations.literal: When legs are many, those below lack unity.
translations.idiomatic: Many legs signify that those below are not of one mind.

sentences.zh: 郊所以奉天。

translations.literal: The suburban rite is how one serves Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban rite is the means by which one serves Heaven.

sentences.zh: 七年，關輔牛大疫，死者十五六。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, a great cattle plague in Guanfu; five or six out of ten died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (791), a great cattle plague struck Guanfu; five or six out of every ten cattle died.

sentences.zh: 咸通七年，荊州民家牛生犢，五足。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xiantong, among the common households of Jingzhou a cow bore a calf with five legs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Xiantong (866), a cow among the common households of Jingzhou bore a calf with five legs.

sentences.zh: 十五年夏，渝州江陽有水牛生驢駒，駒死。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifteenth year, in Jiangyang of Yuzhou a water buffalo bore a mule foal; the foal died.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fifteenth year (874), a water buffalo in Jiangyang, Yuzhou, bore a mule foal, but the foal died.

sentences.zh: 光啟元年，河東有牛人言，其家殺而食之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangqi, in Hedong there was a cow that spoke; its household killed it and ate it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangqi (885), a cow in Hedong spoke; its owners killed it and ate the meat.

sentences.zh: 二年，延州膚施有牛死復生。

translations.literal: In the second year, in Fushi of Yanzhou a cow died and came back to life.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (886), a cow in Fushi, Yanzhou, died and then came back to life.

sentences.zh: 黃眚黃祥。

translations.literal: Yellow calamities and yellow auspices.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow omens and yellow portents.

sentences.zh: 貞觀七年三月丁卯，雨土。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the dingmao day, of the seventh year of Zhenguan, earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year of Zhenguan (633), on the dingmao day, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 二十年閏三月己酉，有黃雲闊一丈，東西際天。

translations.literal: In the intercalary third month, on the jiyou day, of the twentieth year, there was yellow cloud one zhang wide stretching from east to west to the horizon.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month of the twentieth year (646), on the jiyou day, a band of yellow cloud one zhang wide stretched from east to west across the entire sky.

sentences.zh: 黃為土功。

translations.literal: Yellow signifies earth works.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow is the color of earth and portends labor upon the land.

sentences.zh: 永徽三年三月辛巳，雨土。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinsi day, of the third year of Yonghui, earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Yonghui (652), on the xinsi day, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 景龍元年六月庚午，陝州雨土。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengwu day, of the first year of Jinglong, earth rained down in Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Jinglong (707), on the gengwu day, earth rained down in Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，雨土。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingchou day, earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingchou day, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載二月丁丑，雨黃土。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the dingchou day, of the thirteenth year of Tianbao, yellow earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirteenth year of Tianbao (754), on the dingchou day, yellow earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 大曆七年十二月丙寅，雨土。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingyin day, of the seventh year of Dali, earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the seventh year of Dali (772), on the bingyin day, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年四月甲戌，雨土。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the jiaxu day, of the second year of Zhenyuan, earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Zhenyuan (786), on the jiaxu day, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 八年二月庚子，雨土。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the gengzi day, of the eighth year, earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year (792), on the gengzi day, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 大和八年十月甲子，土霧晝昏，至于十一月癸丑。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the jiazi day, of the eighth year of Dahe, an earth fog darkened the day, continuing until the guichou day of the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: From the jiazi day of the tenth month of the eighth year of Dahe (834) until the guichou day of the eleventh month, a haze of earth dust darkened the daylight.

sentences.zh: 開成元年七月乙亥，雨土。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the yihai day, of the first year of Kaicheng, earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Kaicheng (836), on the yihai day, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 咸通十四年三月癸巳，雨黃土。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the guisi day, of the fourteenth year of Xiantong, yellow earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourteenth year of Xiantong (873), on the guisi day, yellow earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 中和二年五月辛酉，大風，雨土。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the xinyou day, of the second year of Zhonghe, a great wind blew and earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Zhonghe (882), on the xinyou day, a great wind blew and earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 天復三年二月，雨土，天地昏霾。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Tianfu, earth rained down; heaven and earth were murky with haze.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of Tianfu (903), earth fell from the sky and heaven and earth were shrouded in murky haze.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年閏四月甲辰，大風，雨土。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the intercalary fourth month of the first year of Tianyou, a great wind blew and earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the intercalary fourth month of the first year of Tianyou (904), a great wind blew and earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 木火金水沴土。

translations.literal: Wood, fire, metal, and water injuring earth.
translations.idiomatic: Wood, fire, metal, and water harming earth.

sentences.zh: 武德二年十月乙未，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the yiwei day, of the second year of Wude, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of Wude (619), on the yiwei day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 陰盛而反常則地震，故其占為臣彊，為后妃專恣，為夷犯華，為小人道長，為寇至，為叛臣。

translations.literal: When yin is excessive and things become abnormal, then there is earthquake; therefore its omen reading is strong ministers, empresses and consorts acting willfully, barbarians violating China, the way of petty men growing long, invaders arriving, and rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When yin grows excessive and the natural order turns abnormal, the earth quakes; the omen is read as strong ministers, willful empresses and consorts, barbarians encroaching upon the Central Lands, petty men gaining the upper hand, invaders arriving, and treacherous ministers rising up.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，巂州地震，山摧壅江，水噎流。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year, an earthquake in Xizhou; mountains collapsed and blocked the river, and the water choked the current.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year (624), an earthquake struck Xizhou; mountains collapsed and dammed the river, choking its flow.

sentences.zh: 貞觀七年十月乙丑，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the yichou day, of the seventh year of Zhenguan, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventh year of Zhenguan (633), on the yichou day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月壬寅，松、叢二州地震，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: In the first month, on the renyin day, of the twelfth year, Song and Cong prefectures earthquake; dwellings were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twelfth year (638), on the renyin day, earthquakes struck Song and Cong prefectures and destroyed dwellings.

sentences.zh: 二十年九月辛亥，靈州地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the xinhai day, of the twentieth year, an earthquake in Lingzhou; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twentieth year (646), on the xinhai day, an earthquake struck Lingzhou with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 二十三年八月癸酉朔，河東地震，晉州尤甚，壓殺五十餘人；

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, the guiyou day, of the twenty-third year, an earthquake in Hedong; Jinzhou was especially severe, crushing and killing more than fifty people;
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month of the twenty-third year (642), the guiyou day, an earthquake struck Hedong; Jinzhou suffered worst of all, crushing more than fifty people to death;

sentences.zh: 乙亥，又震。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，又震。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the yichou day, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yichou day, it shook again.

sentences.zh: 永徽元年四月己巳朔，晉州地震；

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month, the jisi day, of the first year of Yonghui, an earthquake in Jinzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of the first year of Yonghui (650), the jisi day, an earthquake struck Jinzhou;

sentences.zh: 己卯，又震。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，又震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengchen day, it shook again; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengchen day, the earth shook again with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 二年十月，又震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year (651), the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，定襄地震。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the wuyin day, an earthquake in Dingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuyin day, an earthquake struck Dingxiang.

sentences.zh: 帝始封晉王，初即位而地屢震，天下將由帝而動搖象也。

translations.literal: The Emperor had first been enfeoffed as Prince of Jin; when he first ascended the throne the earth repeatedly shook—an image that the realm would be shaken by the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had first been enfeoffed as Prince of Jin; when he first took the throne the earth shook again and again—a sign that the realm would be unsettled through him.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳二年正月庚辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the first month, on the gengchen day, of the second year of Yifeng, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Yifeng (677), on the gengchen day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 永淳元年十月甲子，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the jiazi day, of the first year of Yongchun, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Yongchun (682), on the jiazi day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 垂拱三年七月乙亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the yihai day, of the third year of Chuigong, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Chuigong (687), on the yihai day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 四年七月戊午，又震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the wuwu day, of the fourth year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year (688), on the wuwu day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，神都地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the wuxu day, an earthquake in Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuxu day, Shendu was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 延載元年四月壬戌，常州地震。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the renxu day, of the first year of Yanzai, an earthquake in Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Yanzai (694), on the renxu day, an earthquake struck Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 大足元年七月乙亥，揚、楚、常、潤、蘇五州地震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the yihai day, of the first year of Dazu, earthquakes in Yang, Chu, Chang, Run, and Su, five prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Dazu (701), on the yihai day, earthquakes struck the five prefectures of Yang, Chu, Chang, Run, and Su.

sentences.zh: 二年八月辛亥，劍南六州地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the xinhai day, of the second year, earthquakes in six prefectures of Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year (702), on the xinhai day, earthquakes struck six prefectures in Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 景龍四年五月丁丑，剡縣地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the dingchou day, of the fourth year of Jinglong, an earthquake in Shan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Jinglong (710), on the dingchou day, an earthquake struck Shan County.

sentences.zh: 景雲三年正月甲戌，幷、汾、絳三州地震，壞廬舍，壓死百餘人。

translations.literal: In the first month, on the jiaxu day, of the third year of Jingyun, earthquakes in Bing, Fen, and Jiang, three prefectures; dwellings were destroyed, and more than a hundred people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of Jingyun (712), on the jiaxu day, earthquakes struck Bing, Fen, and Jiang prefectures, destroying dwellings and crushing more than a hundred people to death.

sentences.zh: 開元二十二年二月壬寅，秦州地震。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the renyin day, of the twenty-second year of Kaiyuan, an earthquake in Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-second year of Kaiyuan (734), on the renyin day, an earthquake struck Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 西北隱隱有聲，坼而復合，經時不止，壞廬舍殆盡，壓死四千餘人。

translations.literal: From the northwest there was a faint sound; the ground split and closed again, continuing without cease for a long time; dwellings were nearly all destroyed, and more than four thousand people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: A faint rumbling came from the northwest; the ground split open and closed again, and the tremors went on without cease; dwellings were nearly all destroyed, and more than four thousand people were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 二十六年三月癸巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the guisi day, of the twenty-sixth year, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-sixth year (738), on the guisi day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 至德元載十一月辛亥朔，河西地震裂有聲，陷廬舍，張掖、酒泉尤甚，至二載三月癸亥乃止。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, the xinhai day, of the first year of Zhide, an earthquake in Hexi with cracking and sound; dwellings collapsed; Zhangye and Jiuquan were especially severe; it did not cease until the third month, on the guihai day, of the second year.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month of the first year of Zhide (756), the xinhai day, Hexi was shaken by an earthquake that cracked the ground with audible roars and swallowed dwellings; Zhangye and Jiuquan suffered worst of all, and the tremors did not stop until the third month of the second year (758), on the guihai day.

sentences.zh: 大曆二年十一月壬申，京師地震，自東北來，其聲如雷者。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the renshen day, of the second year of Dali, the capital earthquake; it came from the northeast, and its sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of Dali (767), on the renshen day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake coming from the northeast with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 三年五月丙戌，又震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingxu day, of the third year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year (768), on the bingxu day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 十二年，恆、定二州地大震，三日乃止，束鹿、寧晉地裂數丈，沙石隨水流出平地，壞廬舍，壓死者數百人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, a great earthquake in Heng and Ding, two prefectures; after three days it ceased; in Shulu and Ningjin the ground split several zhang; sand and stones flowed out onto level ground with the water; dwellings were destroyed, and several hundred people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (777), Heng and Ding prefectures were struck by a great earthquake that continued for three days; in Shulu and Ningjin the ground split open several zhang, sand and stones surged with water onto the plain, dwellings were destroyed, and several hundred people were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 建中元年四月己亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the jihai day, of the first year of Jianzhong, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Jianzhong (780), on the jihai day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 三年六月甲子，又震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiazi day, of the third year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year (782), on the jiazi day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 四年四月甲子，又震。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the jiazi day, of the fourth year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year (783), on the jiazi day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，又震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年五月己酉，又震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiyou day, of the second year of Zhenyuan, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Zhenyuan (786), on the jiyou day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 三年十一月丁丑夜，京師、東都、蒲、陝地震。

translations.literal: On the night of the eleventh month, on the dingchou day, of the third year, earthquakes in the capital, the Eastern Capital, Pu, and Shan.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the eleventh month of the third year (787), on the dingchou day, earthquakes struck the capital, the Eastern Capital, and Pu and Shan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 四年正月庚戌朔夜，京師地震；

translations.literal: On the night of the first day of the first month, the gengxu day, of the fourth year, the capital earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the first day of the first month of the fourth year (788), the gengxu day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake;

sentences.zh: 辛亥、壬子、丁卯、戊辰、庚午、癸酉、甲戌、乙亥，皆震，金、房二州尤甚，江溢山裂，屋宇多壞，人皆露處。

translations.literal: On the xinhai, renzi, dingmao, wuchen, gengwu, guiyou, jiaxu, and yihai days, all shook; Jin and Fang, two prefectures, were especially severe; rivers overflowed and mountains split; many buildings were destroyed, and people all slept in the open.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai, renzi, dingmao, wuchen, gengwu, guiyou, jiaxu, and yihai days, the earth shook again and again; Jin and Fang prefectures suffered worst of all, rivers overflowed and mountains split open, many buildings were ruined, and people were forced to sleep out in the open.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，京師又震；

translations.literal: In the second month, on the renwu day, the capital shook again;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renwu day, the capital shook again;

sentences.zh: 甲申、乙酉、丙申，三月甲寅、己未、庚午、辛未，五月丙寅、丁卯，皆震。

translations.literal: On the jiashen, yiyou, and bingshen days; in the third month on the jiayin, jiwei, gengwu, and xinwei days; in the fifth month on the bingyin and dingmao days—all shook.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen, yiyou, and bingshen days; in the third month on the jiayin, jiwei, gengwu, and xinwei days; and in the fifth month on the bingyin and dingmao days—the earth shook each time.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，又震，有聲如雷；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jiawu day, it shook again; there was a sound like thunder;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiawu day, the earth shook again with a sound like thunder;

sentences.zh: 甲辰，又震。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 九年四月辛酉，又震，有聲如雷，河中、關輔尤甚，壞城壁廬舍，地裂水涌。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, in the fourth month, on the xinyou day, it shook again; there was a sound like thunder; Hezhong and Guanfu were especially severe; city walls and dwellings were destroyed; the ground split and water surged forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the ninth year (793), on the xinyou day, the earth shook again with a sound like thunder; Hezhong and the Guanfu region suffered worst of all, city walls and dwellings were destroyed, the ground split open, and water gushed forth.

sentences.zh: 十年四月戊申，京師地震；

translations.literal: In the tenth year, in the fourth month, on the wushen day, the capital earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the tenth year (794), on the wushen day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake;

sentences.zh: 癸丑，又震，侍中渾瑊第有樹湧出，樹枝皆戴蚯蚓。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, it shook again; at the mansion of Grand Counselor Hun Jian a tree burst forth, and every branch bore earthworms upon it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the earth shook again; at the mansion of Grand Counselor Hun Jian a tree suddenly sprang up from the ground, and every branch was covered with earthworms.

sentences.zh: 十三年七月乙未，又震。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, in the seventh month, on the yiwei day, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year (797), on the yiwei day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 元和七年八月，京師地震，草樹皆搖。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year of Yuanhe, the capital earthquake; grasses and trees all swayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year of Yuanhe (812), an earthquake shook the capital, and grasses and trees swayed with it.

sentences.zh: 九年三月丙辰，巂州地震，晝夜八十，壓死百餘人，地陷者三十里。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the bingchen day, of the ninth year, an earthquake in Xizhou; eighty times day and night; more than a hundred people were crushed to death; the ground subsided for thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year (814), on the bingchen day, an earthquake struck Xizhou and trembled eighty times day and night, crushing more than a hundred people to death; the ground subsided over an area of thirty li.

sentences.zh: 十年十月，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the tenth year, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the tenth year (815), the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月丁丑，又震。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the dingchou day, of the eleventh year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year (816), on the dingchou day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，穆宗即位，戊辰，始朝羣臣於宣政殿，是夜地震。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year, Muzong ascended the throne; on the wuchen day he first held court with the assembled ministers at Xuanzheng Hall, and that night there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year (820), Muzong ascended the throne; on the wuchen day he first received the assembled ministers in audience at Xuanzheng Hall, and that very night the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 大和二年正月壬申，地震。

translations.literal: In the first month, on the renshen day, of the second year of Taihe, an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Taihe (828), on the renshen day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 七年六月甲戌，又震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiaxu day, of the seventh year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year (833), on the jiaxu day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 九年三月乙卯，京師地震，屋瓦皆墜，戶牖間有聲。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yimao day, of the ninth year, the capital earthquake; roof tiles all fell; there was sound between doors and windows.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year (835), on the yimao day, an earthquake shook the capital, roof tiles fell everywhere, and sounds rattled through doors and windows.

sentences.zh: 開成元年二月乙亥，又震。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the yihai day, of the first year of Kaicheng, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Kaicheng (836), on the yihai day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月乙丑夜，又震。

translations.literal: On the night of the eleventh month, on the yichou day, of the second year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the eleventh month of the second year (837), on the yichou day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月甲戌，又震。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiaxu day, of the fourth year, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourth year (839), on the jiaxu day, the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 會昌二年正月癸亥，宋、亳二州地震。

translations.literal: In the first month, on the guihai day, of the second year of Huichang, earthquakes in Song and Bo, two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Huichang (842), on the guihai day, earthquakes struck Song and Bo prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guiwei day, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guiwei day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 大中三年十月辛巳，上都及振武、河西、天德、靈武、鹽夏等州地震，壞廬舍，壓死數十人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the xinsi day, of the third year of Dazhong, earthquakes in the Upper Capital and Zhenwu, Hexi, Tiande, Lingwu, Yanxia, and other prefectures; dwellings were destroyed, and several tens of people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of Dazhong (849), on the xinsi day, earthquakes struck the Upper Capital and the prefectures of Zhenwu, Hexi, Tiande, Lingwu, Yanxia, and others, destroying dwellings and crushing several tens of people to death.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月丁巳，太原地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the dingsi day, of the twelfth year, an earthquake in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twelfth year (858), on the dingsi day, an earthquake struck Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 咸通元年五月，上都地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Xiantong, the Upper Capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Xiantong (860), the Upper Capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六年十二月，晉、絳二州地震，壞廬舍，地裂泉湧，泥出青色。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixth year, earthquakes in Jin and Jiang, two prefectures; dwellings were destroyed; the ground split and springs surged forth; mud emerged blue-green.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixth year (865), earthquakes struck Jin and Jiang prefectures, destroying dwellings; the ground split open and springs gushed forth, and blue-green mud welled up.

sentences.zh: 八年正月丁未，河中、晉、絳三州地大震，壞廬舍，人有死者。

translations.literal: In the first month, on the dingwei day, of the eighth year, a great earthquake in Hezhong, Jin, and Jiang, three prefectures; dwellings were destroyed, and some people died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year (867), on the dingwei day, a great earthquake struck Hezhong, Jin, and Jiang prefectures, destroying dwellings and killing people.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月庚子朔，浙東、西地震。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month, the gengzi day, of the thirteenth year, earthquakes in eastern and western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of the thirteenth year (872), the gengzi day, earthquakes struck eastern and western Zhe.

sentences.zh: 乾符三年六月乙丑，雄州地震，至七月辛巳止，州城廬舍盡壞，地陷水湧，傷死甚眾。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yichou day, of the third year of Qianfu, an earthquake in Xiongzhou; it ceased on the xinsi day of the seventh month; the prefectural city and dwellings were all destroyed; the ground subsided and water surged forth; the wounded and dead were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year of Qianfu (876), on the yichou day, an earthquake struck Xiongzhou and did not stop until the xinsi day of the seventh month; the prefectural city and all its dwellings were destroyed, the ground sank and water gushed forth, and casualties were very heavy.

sentences.zh: 是月，濮州地震。

translations.literal: In that month, an earthquake in Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In that same month, an earthquake struck Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，京師地震有聲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the capital earthquake with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the capital was shaken by an earthquake that could be heard.

sentences.zh: 四年六月庚寅，雄州地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengyin day, of the fourth year, an earthquake in Xiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year (877), on the gengyin day, an earthquake struck Xiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，京師地震，有聲如雷，藍田山裂水湧。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, the capital earthquake; there was a sound like thunder; Lantian Mountain split and water surged forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year (879), an earthquake shook the capital with a sound like thunder; Lantian Mountain split open and water gushed forth.

sentences.zh: 中和三年秋，晉州地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year of Zhonghe, an earthquake in Jinzhou; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the third year of Zhonghe (883), an earthquake struck Jinzhou with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 光啟二年春，成都地震，月中十數。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Guangqi, earthquakes in Chengdu; more than ten times within the month.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of Guangqi (886), Chengdu was shaken by earthquakes more than ten times within the month.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵、饑。

translations.literal: The omen reading says: "War and famine.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading says: "War and famine.

sentences.zh: 」十二月，魏州地震。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month, an earthquake in Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month, an earthquake struck Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾寧二年三月庚午，河東地震。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the gengwu day, of the second year of Qianning, an earthquake in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Qianning (895), on the gengwu day, an earthquake struck Hedong.

sentences.zh: 山摧。

translations.literal: Mountains collapsing.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains collapsing.

sentences.zh: 貞觀八年七月，隴右山摧。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eighth year of Zhenguan, mountains collapsed in Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year of Zhenguan (634), mountains collapsed in Longyou.

sentences.zh: 山者高峻，自上而隕之象也。

translations.literal: Mountains are lofty and steep; this is an image of falling from above.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains are lofty and steep; their collapse is an image of ruin falling from on high.

sentences.zh: 垂拱二年九月己巳，雍州新豐縣露臺鄉大風雨，震電，有山湧出，高二十丈，有池周三百畝，池中有龍鳳之形，禾麥之異，武后以為休應，名曰「慶山」。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jisi day, of the second year of Chuigong, in Lütai township of Xinfeng County, Yongzhou, there was a great wind and rain with thunder and lightning; a mountain burst forth, twenty zhang high, with a pool three hundred mu in circumference; in the pool were forms of dragon and phoenix and strange grain and wheat; Empress Wu took it as a felicitous response and named it "Celebration Mountain."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Chuigong (686), on the jisi day, a great storm with thunder and lightning struck Lütai township in Xinfeng County, Yongzhou; a mountain suddenly surged up twenty zhang high, ringed by a pool three hundred mu around; within the pool appeared shapes of dragon and phoenix and strange grain and wheat; Empress Wu took this as a blessed omen and named it "Celebration Mountain."

sentences.zh: 荊州人俞文俊上言：「天氣不和而寒暑隔，人氣不和而贅疣生，地氣不和而堆阜出。

translations.literal: Yu Wenjun of Jingzhou submitted a memorial saying: "When heavenly qi is not harmonious, cold and heat are separated; when human qi is not harmonious, wens and warts arise; when earthly qi is not harmonious, mounds burst forth."
translations.idiomatic: Yu Wenjun of Jingzhou submitted a memorial saying: "When heaven's qi falls out of harmony, cold and heat are estranged; when human qi falls out of harmony, wens and warts appear; when earth's qi falls out of harmony, mounds rise up."

sentences.zh: 今陛下以女主居陽位，反易剛柔，故地氣隔塞，山變為災。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty, a female ruler occupying the yang position, has reversed hard and soft; therefore earthly qi is blocked and obstructed, and mountains turn into disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty, a woman ruler occupying the yang position, has reversed hard and soft; therefore earthly qi is blocked and estranged, and mountains become calamity.

sentences.zh: 陛下以為『慶山』，臣以為非慶也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty takes it as the 'Celebration Mountain,' but your subject considers it no celebration.
